title: Cyclist Gravely Injured After Hitting CFE Truck While Riding Against Traffic in Nuevo Laredo
excerpt: Ramón Darío, 43, was gravely injured Sunday morning after the bicycle he was riding struck the front of a Comisión Federal de Electricidad truck on avenida César López de Lara in Nuevo Laredo. He was riding against traffic, according to Hoy Tamaulipas.
content:
Ramón Darío, 43, was gravely injured Sunday morning after the bicycle he was riding struck the front of a Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE) truck in Nuevo Laredo, according to Hoy Tamaulipas.

Darío was riding against traffic on avenida César López de Lara, in colonia México, at the intersection with calle Anáhuac, when he hit a 2020 Chevrolet Silverado belonging to the CFE, the newspaper reported.

The truck’s driver, identified only as Miguel, told authorities he had just started moving after the traffic light turned green, according to the report.

Protección Civil paramedics gave Darío first aid at the scene and took him to Hospital General, where he remained under medical care, the newspaper reported. He was carrying barbacoa home, which spilled onto the pavement in the crash.

Transit agents documented the crash and impounded the vehicles involved, according to the report.

Source: Hoy Tamaulipas, November 15, 2026
